Name: Culprit Reader
Description: Read-only access for the Culprit patch-failure RCA agent. Grants exactly what collection needs (Resource Graph, Activity Log, Log Analytics, and read-only Run Command) and nothing that can change a resource. Phase 1 grants only this role - no Contributor, no Owner, on any scope.
_comment_run_command_action: The DataAction above is what actually invokes Run Command. It is scoped down further at the application layer, not just RBAC: culprit/collectors/guest_linux.py and guest_windows.py hard-code a fixed, reviewed, read-only script - there is no code path in this repository that accepts an arbitrary script to run. Extending the allow-listed commands requires a code change and review, not a config change.
_comment_no_write: There is deliberately no Microsoft.Compute/*/write, Microsoft.Maintenance/*/write, or any Contributor-equivalent action anywhere in this role. Phase 1 is read-only by construction (proposal Section 3/12): Culprit cannot change a resource even if a bug or a prompt-injected instruction told it to, because the credential it runs as has no write permission to invoke.
